title: Prominence The 30 Way Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewHot Tub6 Seat Golf Cart & 4 Bikes Included! Community Pool and The Big Chill! `The 30 Way`The Space 30 Way – Luxury Prominence Home with Golf Cart & Steps to The Big Chill! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 6-Seater Street Legal Golf Cart Included – Explore 30A in style & convenience Steps to The Big Chill (The Hub) – Walk to dining, live music, & entertainment 5,000 SF Resort-Style Community Pool – Featuring private cabanas & outdoor dining pavilion 4 Adult Bikes Included – Ride to nearby beaches & scenic coastal paths High-End Coastal Furnishings – Elegant design with premium finishes Spacious 3 Bedrooms + Bunk Room – Sleeps the whole family comfortably Smart TVs & Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected & entertained Gas Grill – Perfect for outdoor cookouts & gatherings Large Front Porch – Relax with friends & family in a peaceful setting Driveway Parking for 2 Cars – Convenient & hassle-free Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stayWelcome to The 30 Way"30 Way" is a charming home located in the exclusive Prominence community on the picturesque 30A corridor, offering a perfect blend of modern amenities and beachy elegance. This vacation rental comes complete with a 6-seat golf cart and 4 bikes, ensuring you can explore the nearby attractions and enjoy the stunning coastal scenery with ease. You will love this place. This home features a modern floor plan with 3 bedrooms and 3.5 baths as well as a bunk room. There is an open concept kitchen, dining and living room area. The master is downstairs and features a king bed, a luxury master bathroom and a large walk-in closet. Upstairs there are 2 bedrooms with queen beds and a bunk room with 4 more twin beds. There are high ceilings and high-quality finishes and furnishings throughout the entire property. Set up shop on the huge front porch and relax with your friends or family.As part of the Prominence neighborhood, guests can take advantage of the luxurious community pool, ideal for relaxing after a day of adventure. The home is also just a short distance from The Big Chill, a vibrant community space featuring great dining options, entertainment, and shops — making it easy to enjoy everything the area has to offer. Live music most nights, excellent food and lots of fun for the little ones. Come watch the game on the 25-foot LED screen or let the kids hang out on the lawn for movie night.With its convenient location, stylish interiors, and fantastic amenities, including the golf cart and bikes, "30 Way" is an ideal retreat for families or groups looking for a relaxing and fun-filled getaway on 30A. The 5,000 sq ft community pool has private cabanas and an outdoor dining pavilion. The location of this development is perfectly placed right in the middle of Seaside & Sea Grove on the west and Alys & Rosemary on the east.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival****NO CABLE. STREAMING ONLY**Beach Access:Deer Lake State Park - 1 mile west , $3 parking Fee Gulf Lakes Public Beach - 1.2 miles eastSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):Master Bedroom: King sized bed, private bathroom with separate tub and showerGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, private bathroom with showerGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboBunk Room: Two set of twin bunk beds, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboAREA ATTRACTIONS:The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) is a festive gathering place for friends and families to eat, drink, shop, and play. There are multiple restaurants plus Mr. Freeze ice cream, and plenty of fine retail shopping. The restaurants are situated around a lawn and patio area with comfortable seating, big stone wood grill, fireplace, event stage, and huge screen. There is music, drinks, entertainment, games and an arcade. There is easy access to the 30A hotspot "The Big Chill", a Pool House with heated pools .Golf Carts: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:-To operate the golf cart, guests must have a valid drivers license and be at least 21 years old.-Please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations-A copy of the golf carts terms and conditions will be emailed upon reservation and will require signatures**Golf cart is not guaranteed. Should the golf cart need to be serviced a backup golf cart will not be provided and no compensation will be given.**PLEASE NOTE - ** FL law states that any underage and/or unlicensed driver of a street legal golf cart is considered a criminal offense and a $500 fine including a possible 60 days in jail. It’s a very serious offense for underage/unlicensed driving of a LSV in the State of FL.***If Prominence security stops any underage drivers they will impose a $500 fine to the house. Guest will be responsible for the payment of the ticket imposed.*Show less
